nodes.name: When Called by WF4
nodes.notes:
Input from WF4 (handoff needed):
{
  conversation_id: UUID,
  phone: '5215512345678',
  assigned_agent_id: 'agent_yolanda',
  current_property: 'EB-12345'
}

parameters.query:
-- Switch conversation to human mode.
UPDATE conversations
SET mode = 'human'
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, assigned_agent_id, current_property;

-- Fetch the assigned agent's details.
SELECT agent_id, name, whatsapp_number, easybroker_email
FROM agents
WHERE agent_id = $1;

-- Fetch last 10 messages for summary.
SELECT direction, sender_type, body, created_at
FROM messages
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
  AND body IS NOT NULL AND body != ''
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, recipient_phone, body, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outbound', 'system', $2, $3, '{"purpose": "handoff"}'::jsonb);
